candidates.raw_text: few F4/80+ Kupffer cells expressed eGFP

evidence.quote: eGFP expression was absent in CK19+ cholangiocytes and α-SMA+ vascular smooth muscle cells, while few F4/80+ Kupffer cells expressed eGFP.

dispositions.reason: Qualitative, population-specific eGFP-expression result in F4/80+ Kupffer cells.
